definitions.explanation: Yarn or thread made from wool or other fibers, used for knitting or crocheting.

examples.japanese: {毛糸|けいと}でセーターを{編|あ}んだ。
examples.english: I knitted a sweater with yarn.

examples.japanese: {手芸店|しゅげいてん}で{毛糸|けいと}を{買|か}った。
examples.english: I bought yarn at the craft store.

examples.japanese: {猫|ねこ}が{毛糸|けいと}の{玉|たま}で{遊|あそ}んでいる。
examples.english: The cat is playing with a ball of yarn.

notes:
COMPOUNDS:
・{毛糸|けいと}の{玉|たま} (ball of yarn)
・{毛糸|けいと}{編|あ}み (wool knitting)

MATERIALS:
・ウール{毛糸|けいと} (wool yarn)
・アクリル{毛糸|けいと} (acrylic yarn)
・{並|なみ}{太|ぶと}{毛糸|けいと} (medium-weight yarn)
・{極|ごく}{太|ぶと}{毛糸|けいと} (bulky yarn)

RELATED WORDS:
・{編|あ}む (to knit)
・{編|あ}み{物|もの} (knitting, knitted item)
・かぎ{針|ばり}{編|あ}み (crochet)
・{棒|ぼう}{針|ばり}{編|あ}み (knitting with needles)
・{糸|いと} (thread - general)

NOTE: {毛糸|けいと} traditionally referred to wool ({毛|け} = hair/fur) but now includes synthetic yarns as well.
